tariff.title: תקנון כלל גמל לעתיד קופת גמל להשקעה
tariff.notes: Bylaws of כלל גמל לעתיד (fund 7987), 15 pages, February 2025 edition; fees in section 35 on p.10. The joining request G550 (May 2025, linked from clalbit.co.il/investmentprovidentfund) leaves the rates blank. Read 2026-11-07. The February 2025 edition is printed as a month; its first day is recorded as published.

source.title: תקנון כלל גמל לעתיד, קופת גמל להשקעה (מהדורת פברואר 2025), סעיף 35.1
source.quote: בשיעור שלא יעלה על שיעור או סכום דמי הניהול השנתי המרבי

rate.notes: Clal's joining and transfer request for כלל גמל לעתיד (form G550, May 2025, p.2) leaves both rates blank ("דמי ניהול __% מצבירה ו-__% מהפקדה"); the fund's bylaws (February 2025 edition, s.35.1, p.10) let the company charge up to the maximum the law sets on the balance and on each payment. Recorded at that maximum, 1.05% of the balance and 4% of deposits (PF-02), as D56 prices an "up to" fee; what a joiner is offered is set in the blank, not published. On top of the fees the company may charge direct expenses for transactions from the fund's assets (no rate printed, not recorded). A member's own agreement sets the fee actually paid (D4).
